<thought>Based on the 13C NMR data, there are three aliphatic carbon signals (≈52, 44, 39 ppm) that fall in the typical region for methyl carbons (including O‑CH₃, N‑CH₃, etc.). The remaining signals correspond to carbonyl and aromatic carbons. Therefore, the molecule contains three CH₃ groups.</thought>
<final_answer>3</final_answer>
